requirement: Implement EPIC-2 story 2.3: validated local-file and YouTube ingest that produces a canonical WAV clip of at most 15 seconds for reduction.

architecture.decision: Add a dedicated sidecar ingest module that validates exactly one source, acquires it into a request-scoped workspace, validates duration, clips it to mono 44.1 kHz WAV, and passes only that clip to the unchanged reduce() interface.
alternatives: Keep decoding and clipping implicit inside reduce()
Let the FastAPI route directly assemble yt-dlp and ffmpeg commands
tradeoffs: A separate ingest seam adds one module but keeps hostile-input validation and subprocess policy testable without Demucs.
Sources are capped at 50 MiB and 30 minutes while selected clips remain capped at 15 seconds; this permits normal songs without allowing unbounded local processing.
